items.title: Pastel component board - workspaces, toggles and doc cards
items.description: A light board of pastel UI cards: workspace copy with 'Jam on' cursor, a Sun/TaskUX/Ficus toggle stack, Design/Engineering/Marketing/Sales chips, a pink 'Product Requirement Doc' card, task rows with 'Mark as done' and yellow agent cards. A component sampler.

items.title: Generative gradients - three pixel panels with an AI side chat
items.description: A design tool: left AI chat ('liquid water', sampling notes), right three generated pixel-gradient panels (blue/green mountains, green light, stitched beach) captioned '01 Water light - simple emotion', '03 Summer - stitched beach'. A generative-art iteration view.

items.title: Grok Bot icon - code-animated face with a launch tweet
items.description: A phone frame showing the black Grok Bot icon (white blob face, coloured ribbon arcs) above Benji Taylor's Aug 11 post: 'Had a lot of fun animating our new Grok Bot icon. It's entirely made in code... I made it with Grok Build.' An icon-launch moment.

items.title: 'Tabs' index - giant type over a field of section chips
items.description: A design-system index page: huge black 'Tabs' headline ringed by white section chips (Kit, Layout, User Flows, Research, Design System, Introducing..., UI Patterns, Icons, Grid System, Prototypes, Frames, Typography, Components). A tabbed docs landing, not an app window.

items.title: Reference cards - 'Capital Metamorphosis' and 'Sensitive Dependencies'
items.description: Two 'MY CARD' reference cards on halftone: a purple dahlia ('Capital Metamorphosis', Efficiency Delta ring) and black-white fabric ('Sensitive Dependencies', Variance Threshold ring), each with Add Card and Tonic tags. A moodboard pair, not 'Delicate Linework'.

items.title: Animation library - alarm preview with palettes and effects
items.description: A 'With Animation - Library / Alarm App' tool: centre 'Set an Alarm' phone (repeat chips, blue radial dial 5:42 PM, Evening Hues.mp3), left Browse list (Capsule Loader, Cards Shuffle, Meetball Particles, Matrix View, Water Ripple, Warp Speed, Glass Refraction), right Inspector with palettes (Ember, Rose, Ocean, Forest, Plum). An animation-library workspace.

items.title: Thinking orbs - animated agent state pills on black
items.description: A dark showcase titled 'Thinking orbs - Animated thinking orbs component': pills reading Agent thinking..., Agent working..., Thinking.... (line orb), Listening.... (dot orb), Agent shaping..., Thinking.... A state-component set.
